local f = workspace.Phase1Map.town1_extra
local sk
for _, m in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do if m:IsA('Model') and m.Name == 'T01_demon_skull_hq' then sk = m end end
if not sk then return 'no skull' end
local cf, sz = sk:GetBoundingBox()
local out = {string.format('skull centre (%.0f,%.1f,%.0f) size (%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)', cf.X, cf.Y, cf.Z, sz.X, sz.Y, sz.Z)}
local okc = 0
for _, p in ipairs(sk:GetDescendants()) do
  if p:IsA('MeshPart') then
    table.insert(out, string.format('  %s mat=%s col=%s size=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f)', p.Name, p.Material.Name, tostring(p.Color), p.Size.X, p.Size.Y, p.Size.Z))
    local ok = pcall(function() p.CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.PreciseConvexDecomposition end)
    if ok then okc += 1 end
  end
end
table.insert(out, 'precise collision set on ' .. okc .. ' pieces')
return table.concat(out, '\n')
